headline: Bring Tuya devices into your home
intro: Connect devices from the Tuya Smart or Smart Life app to Home Assistant through Tuya's cloud service. Sign in by scanning a QR code with the app, then use supported device entities and app-created scenes in your automations. Devices paired to a phone over Bluetooth need a Tuya Bluetooth or multi-mode gateway so their status is available to the cloud.
highlights: Connect devices already added to a Tuya Smart or Smart Life account
Use supported entities and Tuya app scenes in Home Assistant
Reload the integration after adding devices to your Tuya account
